title: PlanScaleResult
description: The plan's scale after the step. With no length_mm nothing moved: measured_mm is the distance between the points at the scale the plan has now.

measured_mm.description: Distance between the two points before the step

factor.description: Scale from the detection's own mm, after the step

relative.description: factor / previous_factor: what the geometry was multiplied by. 1 on a repeat.

scaled.description: Objects moved, the underlay included. 0 when only measuring.

walls_recleaned.description: The imported wall outlines were cleaned again from the detection at the new scale, so their thickness is rounded to 10 mm there. false: they scaled as drawn (edited since the import), or nothing moved.
